questions.key: 10th lord Saturn sits in its own house (Kumbham) in the 10th = strong career. A time window must come from a bhukti linked to the 10th/6th/2nd/11th (e.g. Venus bhukti 03-05-2027 to 03-07-2028, Venus rules the 6th = service) or Saturn's transit in the 11th from lagnam. Mercury bhukti alone (2nd/5th lord) is not a job reason.

questions.text: Karthik local-la velai paakkanuma illa velinaattukku pogalama?
questions.key: 12th lord Mars sits in its own house in the 12th and Mars dasa is running (2022-2029); Ketu bhukti (Ketu in the 12th, 06-12-2026 to 03-05-2027) also links to the 12th = abroad chance high. 4th lord Sun in lagnam is the home-town side. 'Stay local because Saturn is in the 10th' is wrong.

12th lord Mars own house in the 12th + Mars dasa support going abroad; 4th lord Sun in lagnam pulls towards home; Rahu dasa from 10-06-2029 (Rahu in the 6th). Long-term settling is mixed and both sides should be explained.

7th lord Mars in the 12th; Venus (marriage karaka for a male) in the 2nd (family); Venus bhukti 03-05-2027 to 03-07-2028 is the natural window; sevvai dosham is present (Mars 12th from lagnam), so matching matters.
5th lord Mercury in lagnam, 7th lord Mars in the 12th: no direct 5th-7th lord link; Venus in the 2nd (family house) leans to a family-arranged marriage. The answer should name the 5th and 7th lords.
2nd lord Mercury in lagnam, lagna lord Venus in the 2nd, 11th lord Jupiter in the 6th and retrograde; Saturn's transit in the 11th from lagnam supports gains now.

10th lord Saturn strong in its own 10th favours a steady job; 7th lord Mars in the 12th (expenses, foreign) is weak for own business. Should lean to job, or explain a mixed picture with these reasons.
Lagna lord Venus in the 2nd; Mars, Moon and Ketu in the 12th; 8th lord Jupiter in the 6th. Must use soft words, name no illness, and suggest a doctor for any real concern.
5th house Kanni is empty, 5th lord Mercury in lagnam; Jupiter (child karaka) retrograde in the 6th: soft, mixed, no promise.
4th lord Sun and 5th lord Mercury in lagnam; 9th lord Saturn in the 10th; 12th lord Mars own house in the 12th + Mars dasa support studies or work abroad.
4th lord Sun in lagnam; Mars (property karaka) in its own sign in the 12th; Sun bhukti 03-07-2028 to 09-11-2028 (Sun = 4th lord) is the house-linked window.
6th lord Venus in the 2nd; Rahu and Jupiter in the 6th (Rahu in the 6th helps overcome debts and enemies). Any period named should link to the 6th/8th/12th.

questions.text: Ippo irukkura company-la promotion kidaikkuma, illa job maaranuma?
questions.key: 10th lord Saturn own house in the 10th; Saturn's transit in the 11th from lagnam (gains); 3rd lord Moon in the 12th and Mars dasa (12th) lean to a change or move. A window must be tied to a named bhukti.

questions.text: Ellarum 2029 varaikkum wait pannu-nu solraanga. Unmaiya?
questions.key: Rahu dasa begins 10-06-2029 (Rahu in the 6th: service, competition). Mars dasa now already supports abroad/12th matters. 'Wait till 2029' needs a reason: the answer should name the Rahu dasa start or explain why not to wait.
